Subject: Evora / Redwood MSA + Order Form — intake and timeline

Hi Mateo,

Thanks again for the intro call last week. Attached are our initial redlines for the Redwood MSA and a completed order form (Evora_OrderForm.xlsx). We want to kick off the contracting work and align on a realistic timeline. High-level asks from our side: 

- We need SOC 2 evidence (latest report + controls matrix).
- Data residency: our primary EU customers require data to be stored in the EU (we're prepared to discuss region-specific hosting).
- KMS/HSM: we use AWS KMS and would like key management details for any customer-managed options.
- Signing authority: Procurement will need the full signatory path and billing contact for invoicing terms.

Can you confirm who on the Redwood contracting team will own this and provide any intake checklist you prefer? We are hoping to have a first pass in ~7 business days if possible.

Attachments: Evora_Redlines_MSA_20270604.pdf, Evora_OrderForm.xlsx

Thanks,
Olivia Barnes

Hi Olivia,

Thanks for sending these over — appreciate the detail. I've looped in our contracts and onboarding leads so we can triage. Quick intake notes and asks from Redwood to make the first-pass redline as accurate as possible:

- Can you confirm the committed monthly spend or target ARR so we can map billing exhibit tiers?
- Is Evora planning a Hosted (Redwood API) deployment or Private (VPC/on-prem) for this engagement?
- If Private, please indicate expected start date and any special residency or export-control constraints.
- Provide the procurement contact for invoicing (name, email, billing address).
- Please share SOC 2 report and the relevant security questionnaire answers (if you have a zip/pack, upload to the Drive link above).
- Any IP carve-outs or data-processing language you expect us to accept (call out specific clauses).

I attached our current MSA template to speed alignment (Redwood_MSA_Template_v3.docx). Plan: Kimberly will lead the commercial redline and Marissa will triage security evidence. I'll coordinate and return a redline tracker and prioritized clause list by Tuesday EOD (2027-06-08). If any of the above items are a blocker, flag them and we'll adjust timeline.

HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/8247 (DEAL-8247)

Thanks — Mateo

- Committed spend: target first-year ARR is ~$450k (monthly cadence); we will share a more granular forecast in the order form.
- Deployment: Hosted API initially; we may evaluate Private in Q4 depending on volume.
- Procurement/billing: Samir Patel, samir.patel@evora.com, +44 20 5555 1299; Billing address: Evora Systems Ltd, 54 Fleet Street, London, EC4Y 1JU.
- SOC 2: included in Evora_Security_Pack.zip (controls matrix + attestation summary).
